app.name: SeedRouter Onboarding
app.tagline: One guided path from environment check to a verified Codex / Claude Code setup

welcome.title: Welcome to SeedRouter Onboarding
welcome.intro: This tool walks you through: checking your machine → installing what is missing → configuring the service gateway in CC Switch → verifying that everything works. No documentation required; when something fails you get the cause and the fix.

whatWeDoItems.check: Detects your OS, Node.js, Codex CLI, Claude Code, CC Switch, environment variables and network reachability
whatWeDoItems.install: Runs install commands only after you confirm, showing the exact command and live progress
whatWeDoItems.guide: Hands you the service gateway address and other standard values and guides you step by step inside CC Switch
whatWeDoItems.verify: Verifies the CLI in a fresh terminal session and sends one minimal test request to the gateway

whatWeDontItems.noConfigWrite: It never silently edits ~/.codex, ~/.claude or CC Switch configuration files: ~/.codex/config.toml is written only after you confirm “Apply the Codex config template” in the Configure step (with a backup); CC Switch writes its own configuration
whatWeDontItems.noEnvEdit: It never changes environment variables without your confirmation: “Clean up environment variables” and “Fix PATH now” show exactly what will change, run only after you confirm, and keep a backup
whatWeDontItems.noKeyStorage: It never stores or uploads your API key (used in memory for connectivity tests, or handed to CC Switch after you confirm the import)

welcome.codexClientHint: Also covers the Codex client / IDE extension — it shares the same configuration as Codex CLI
welcome.telemetryNotice: To help IT improve the process, the tool can report anonymous step success rates and durations (no keys, URLs or personal data).

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.config: Configuration could not be loaded; built-in defaults are in use.
errors.hash_mismatch: Downloaded file failed verification and may be corrupt or tampered with. Do not run it.

open_system_uri_hint.ms_store_codex_app: Opens the Codex client page in the Microsoft Store — click “Get” to install
open_system_uri_hint.windows_region_settings: If the Store says the app is not available in your region: change the country/region, then reopen the Store

fixes.adminHint: Needs administrator rights: the system will ask for permission

remediate.helpLink: Learn what this button does behind the scenes
remediate.restartTerminals: Close every terminal window (and CC Switch) and open them again so the new setting takes effect.

path.title: Fix PATH
path.description: Adds the folder below to your user PATH so the terminal can find the commands in it. Only your own user settings change; no administrator rights needed.
path.backupNote: The original file is backed up first (same name plus .seedrouter-<time>.bak).
path.alreadyPresent: PATH already contains this folder, so nothing needs to change — usually closing every terminal window and opening a new one is enough. Confirming makes no change.

result.title: PATH fixed
result.unchanged: PATH already contained {{dir}}; nothing was changed.

env.title: Clean up environment variables
env.description: The variables below will be removed. Each row shows where it comes from and its full current value — please review before confirming.
env.adminWarning: Some of these are system-wide variables; removing them needs administrator rights (a UAC prompt will appear).
env.valuesShownNote: Full values are shown in this dialog only; they are never logged or reported.

action.delete_user_registry: Delete from the Windows user variables
action.delete_machine_registry: Delete from the Windows system variables — needs administrator rights, a UAC prompt will appear
action.comment_out_rc_line: Comment out this line in the file (backup first)
action.launchctl_unsetenv: Run launchctl unsetenv to unset it
action.none: Cannot remove: it is only set in the current process — close and reopen the program or terminal that launched this tool

ui.copyFailed: Copy failed — please select the text and copy it by hand
ui.secretMasked: Part of this value is hidden for safety; copying uses the full real value.

configSource.bundled_with_override: Config source: bundled preset + local override
